description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to register localization services, including support for Portable Object files, data annotations localization, and data storage localization within an OrchardCore project.

classes.name: LocalizationServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to add localization services.

methods.name: AddPortableObjectLocalization
methods.description: Registers services for localization using Portable Object files, with optional configuration.

methods.name: AddDataAnnotationsPortableObjectLocalization
methods.description: Enables localization of data annotation attributes from portable object files.

methods.name: AddDataLocalization
methods.description: Registers services for localization using data storage.
